# Lab 6.16: Impersonate a Service Account with gcloud

## What We Are Going to Do
Act as a service account for one command, without any key file, using short-lived credentials.

## Steps

1. **Create a service account with read access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts create deployer-sa --display-name="Deployer"
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=serviceAccount:deployer-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/compute.viewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Allow yourself to impersonate it.** Grant **Service Account Token Creator** on this one account only.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding \
  deployer-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member=user:YOUR_EMAIL \
  --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Run one command as the service account.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances list \
  --impersonate-service-account=deployer-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Get a short-lived token.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud auth print-access-token \
  --impersonate-service-account=deployer-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The token expires after one hour by default.

5. **See it in the logs.** In **Logs Explorer**, run this query. The entry shows both the service account and you as the original caller in `serviceAccountDelegationInfo`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • TEXT
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="deployer-sa@YOUR_PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts delete deployer-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Key files | None needed |
| Token lifetime | Short-lived, one hour by default |
| Audit trail | Shows the real person behind the call |
| Role needed | Service Account Token Creator on that account |
